form: Application for Food Processing Plant or Food Storage Facility

title.en: Illinois food processing plant or food storage facility permit
title.zh: 伊利诺伊州食品加工厂或食品仓储设施许可

agency.en: Illinois Department of Public Health, Manufactured Food Program
agency.zh: 伊利诺伊州公共卫生局加工食品项目

how.en: A plant that makes, packs or labels food for wholesale, or a warehouse that stores it, mails the application with a check to IDPH in Springfield at least 45 days before it starts. An inspection follows before the permit is issued.
how.zh: 为批发而生产、包装或贴标食品的工厂，或储存食品的仓库，须至少在开业前 45 天将申请表连同支票邮寄至斯普林菲尔德的州公共卫生局。发证前须经检查。

feeNote.en: A $250 application fee plus the initial fee for the facility type: $650 for a general food storage facility, $950 for a general food processing plant. Renews each year.
feeNote.zh: 申请费 250 美元，另加设施类型的首次费用：普通食品仓储设施 650 美元，普通食品加工厂 950 美元。每年续期。

takes.en: Give IDPH at least 45 days' notice before you operate.
takes.zh: 须至少在营业前 45 天通知州公共卫生局。

renews.zh: 每年 12 月 1 日前续期。

attach.en: Floor plan, product labels and the pre-inspection questionnaire
attach.zh: 平面图、产品标签和检查前问卷

plain.en: The state permit for a food plant or food warehouse in Illinois. Inspected before it's issued.
plain.zh: 伊利诺伊州食品工厂或食品仓库的州许可，发证前须检查。

proof.quote: Food processing plants and food storage facilities are required to obtain a permit and inspection from IDPH to operate.

title.en: Indiana Registered Retail Merchant Certificate (sales tax)
title.zh: 印第安纳州注册零售商证书（销售税）

how.en: Register for sales tax in INBiz. DOR issues a Registered Retail Merchant Certificate for each location, displayed there.
how.zh: 在 INBiz 登记销售税。税务局为每个营业地点签发注册零售商证书，须在该地点张贴。

feeNote.en: A one-time $25 registration fee per location.
feeNote.zh: 每个营业地点一次性登记费 25 美元。

foreign.en: INBiz asks for owners' Social Security numbers; an owner without one tells DOR so before filing.
foreign.zh: INBiz 会要求填写股东的社会安全号；没有的股东须在提交前告知税务局。

plain.en: Lets you charge sales tax in Indiana. $25 per location.
plain.zh: 让您可以在印第安纳州收取销售税。每个地点 25 美元。

proof.quote: This registration allows you to legally conduct retail sales in the state of Indiana.

title.zh: 印第安纳州预扣税登记

how.en: Register for withholding in INBiz, or add the withholding tax type to an existing DOR account when you hire your first employee.
how.zh: 在 INBiz 登记预扣税；已有税务局账户的，雇用首名员工时添加预扣税类别。

feeNote.en: DOR's page states no fee for withholding.
feeNote.zh: 税务局页面未说明预扣税登记费用。

plain.en: Lets you take Indiana state and county income tax out of paychecks.
plain.zh: 让您可以从工资中代扣印第安纳州和县所得税。

proof.quote: A business that has employees will need to register for withholding tax.

form: New employer registration (Uplink Employer Self Service)

title.zh: 失业保险雇主登记

agency.zh: 印第安纳州劳动力发展局

how.en: Register online in Uplink Employer Self Service after the first Indiana payroll, without waiting for the first quarterly report. A paper form exists but slows it down.
how.zh: 在印第安纳州首次发薪后，通过 Uplink 雇主自助系统在线登记，不必等到首份季度报告。也可用纸质表格，但会明显延误。

feeNote.en: DWD's page lists no registration fee.
feeNote.zh: 劳动力发展局页面未列出登记费。

plain.en: Registers you as an employer with the state once you run payroll.
plain.zh: 开始发薪后，向州政府登记为雇主。

proof.quote: The organization should register online using the Uplink Employer Self Service (ESS) website

title.zh: 印第安纳州食品批发场所登记

agency.en: Indiana Department of Health, Wholesale Manufactured Foods Program
agency.zh: 印第安纳州卫生局批发加工食品项目

how.en: A manufacturer, processor, repackager or wholesale distributor of food with a place of business in Indiana registers with the Department of Health on its online form, at least 30 days before it starts.
how.zh: 在印第安纳州设有营业场所的食品生产、加工、分装或批发企业，须至少在开业前 30 天通过州卫生局的在线表格登记。

feeNote.en: The Department of Health's page states no fee.
feeNote.zh: 州卫生局页面未说明费用。

takes.en: Submit at least 30 days before operations start.
takes.zh: 须至少在开业前 30 天提交。

plain.en: A food maker or food warehouse in Indiana registers with the state health department a month before opening.
plain.zh: 印第安纳州的食品生产商或食品仓库须在开业前一个月向州卫生局登记。

proof.quote: requires any manufacturer, processor, repackager, or wholesale distributor of food, drugs, or cosmetics that maintains a place of business in Indiana to register

title.zh: 俄亥俄州经销商执照（销售税）

how.en: Before the first taxable sale, get a vendor's license for each fixed location in OH|TAX eServices (an account comes first), or from the county auditor.
how.zh: 首笔应税销售前，为每个固定营业地点通过 OH|TAX eServices（须先开设账户）或向县审计官申请经销商执照。

feeNote.en: $50 per license since April 9, 2025.
feeNote.zh: 自 2025 年 4 月 9 日起每张执照 50 美元。

plain.en: Lets you charge sales tax in Ohio. One license per location, $50.
plain.zh: 让您可以在俄亥俄州收取销售税。每个地点一张执照，50 美元。

proof.quote: Ohio law requires any person or business making taxable sales or providing taxable services to first obtain a vendor license.

title.zh: 俄亥俄州雇主预扣税登记

how.en: Register online in OH|TAX eServices within 15 days of when withholding begins, with the FEIN, legal name and an email address. The same account covers school district withholding.
how.zh: 须在开始预扣后 15 天内通过 OH|TAX eServices 在线登记，需提供 FEIN、法定名称和电子邮箱。该账户同时用于学区所得税预扣。

feeNote.en: The Department of Taxation's page states no fee.
feeNote.zh: 税务局页面未说明费用。

takes.en: Register within 15 days of when withholding begins.
takes.zh: 须在开始预扣后 15 天内登记。

plain.en: Lets you take Ohio income tax out of paychecks. Register within 15 days of the first payroll.
plain.zh: 让您可以从工资中代扣俄亥俄州所得税。首次发薪后 15 天内登记。

proof.quote: All employers required to withhold Ohio income taxes must register within 15 days of when such liability begins.

form: Food processing establishment registration (Ohio Revised Code 3715.041)

title.zh: 俄亥俄州食品加工场所登记

agency.en: Ohio Department of Agriculture, Division of Food Safety
agency.zh: 俄亥俄州农业厅食品安全处

how.en: A premises that processes, packs or holds food for wholesale (a bakery, bottler, warehouse or distributor) registers every year with the Department of Agriculture. A new establishment is inspected first and then given the application.
how.zh: 为批发而加工、包装或储存食品的场所（面包房、装瓶厂、仓库或分销商）每年须向农业厅登记。新场所先经检查，合格后才发给申请表。

feeNote.en: Set by rule; varies.
feeNote.zh: 按规章确定，金额不一。

renews.zh: 每年续期，须于 1 月 31 日前寄出（以邮戳为准）。

plain.en: A food plant or food warehouse in Ohio registers with the state agriculture department each year, after an inspection.
plain.zh: 俄亥俄州的食品工厂或食品仓库经检查后，每年向州农业厅登记。

proof.quote: A person that operates a food processing establishment shall register the establishment annually with the director of agriculture.

title.zh: 密歇根州销售税执照

how.en: Register on Treasury's online e-Registration in Michigan Treasury Online (Start a New Business), or sign and mail Form 518. Online, the sales tax license can come in as little as 7 business days.
how.zh: 在 Michigan Treasury Online 的在线登记（Start a New Business）中办理，或签署 518 表邮寄。在线办理最快 7 个工作日即可取得销售税执照。

feeNote.en: Treasury's pages state no fee.
feeNote.zh: 财政部页面未说明费用。

takes.en: As little as 7 business days online.
takes.zh: 在线最快 7 个工作日。

plain.en: Lets you charge sales tax in Michigan. Register online before your first sale.
plain.zh: 让您可以在密歇根州收取销售税。首笔销售前在线登记。

proof.quote: Individuals or businesses that sell tangible personal property to the final consumer also need a sales tax license.

form: Form 518, Registration for Michigan Taxes, withholding

title.zh: 密歇根州所得税预扣登记

how.en: Add withholding on the same e-Registration (or Form 518) when the business has Michigan employees. Some Michigan cities levy their own income tax and register employers separately.
how.zh: 企业有密歇根州员工时，在同一在线登记（或 518 表）中添加预扣税。部分密歇根城市另征城市所得税，须另行向城市登记。

feeNote.en: Treasury's pages state no fee.
feeNote.zh: 财政部页面未说明费用。

plain.en: Lets you take Michigan income tax out of paychecks.
plain.zh: 让您可以从工资中代扣密歇根州所得税。

proof.quote: All new businesses that have Michigan employees must register with the Internal Revenue Service (IRS) and the Michigan Department of Treasury

title.zh: 失业保险雇主登记

how.en: An employer with employees covered by Michigan UI law registers for an employer account through the online e-Registration (it needs the FEIN), then manages it in MiUI.
how.zh: 雇用受密歇根州失业保险法覆盖员工的雇主，须通过在线登记（需 FEIN）开立雇主账户，之后在 MiUI 中管理。

feeNote.en: UIA's page lists no registration fee.
feeNote.zh: 失业保险局页面未列出登记费。

plain.en: Registers you as an employer with the state once you have staff.
plain.zh: 有员工后，向州政府登记为雇主。

proof.quote: If you have employees covered by Michigan UI law, you must register for an employer account.

title.zh: 密歇根州食品场所执照

agency.en: Michigan Department of Agriculture and Rural Development (MDARD)
agency.zh: 密歇根州农业与农村发展厅（MDARD）

how.en: Grocery and other retail food stores, wholesale food processors and food warehouses apply to MDARD 30 days before opening, online in the Licensing Portal System (a MiLogin account) or by mail. The license is issued after an inspection.
how.zh: 食品杂货等零售食品店、批发食品加工商和食品仓库须在开业前 30 天向 MDARD 申请，可在 Licensing Portal System（需 MiLogin 账户）在线办理或邮寄。检查合格后发证。

feeNote.en: By license type: $186 for a retail food establishment, limited wholesale food processor or food warehouse; $471 for an extended retail food establishment or a wholesale food processor.
feeNote.zh: 按执照类型：零售食品场所、小型批发食品加工商或食品仓库 186 美元；扩展零售食品场所或批发食品加工商 471 美元。

takes.en: Apply 30 days before the planned opening.
takes.zh: 须在计划开业日前 30 天申请。

renews.en: The license year runs May 1 to April 30.
renews.zh: 执照年度为 5 月 1 日至次年 4 月 30 日。

plain.en: The state food license for a grocery store, food plant or food warehouse in Michigan. Restaurants get theirs from the local health department.
plain.zh: 密歇根州食品杂货店、食品工厂或食品仓库的州食品执照。餐厅由当地卫生部门发证。

proof.quote: For example, grocery stores, food warehouses, and bakeries need food establishment licenses.

title.zh: 威斯康星州销售许可证（销售税）

how.en: Apply at least three weeks before opening, in My Tax Account (Register a Business) or by faxing Form BTR-101. Post the permit at each location.
how.zh: 须至少在开业前三周申请，可在 My Tax Account（Register a Business）在线办理，或传真 BTR-101 表。每个营业地点须张贴许可证。

feeNote.en: A $20 business tax registration fee covering two years, then $10 to renew. Billed by the department.
feeNote.zh: 企业税务登记费 20 美元，有效两年，之后续期 10 美元。由税务局开账单。

takes.en: Online: the permit number by email in one to two business days.
takes.zh: 在线办理：一至两个工作日内通过电子邮件收到许可证号。

renews.zh: 每两年续期一次（10 美元）。

plain.en: Lets you charge sales tax in Wisconsin. $20, apply three weeks before opening.
plain.zh: 让您可以在威斯康星州收取销售税。20 美元，开业前三周申请。

proof.quote: A seller's permit is required for every individual, partnership, corporation, or other organization with a Wisconsin sales location making retail sales

form: Application for Business Tax Registration (BTR-101), withholding

title.zh: 威斯康星州预扣税登记

how.en: Register for a Wisconsin withholding tax account number in My Tax Account, or by faxing Form BTR-101. A business already registered adds withholding to its account.
how.zh: 在 My Tax Account 在线申请威斯康星州预扣税账号，或传真 BTR-101 表。已登记的企业在其账户中添加预扣税。

feeNote.en: $20 for a new registration, valid two years; no extra fee when added to an active registration.
feeNote.zh: 新登记 20 美元，有效两年；在有效登记中添加则不另收费。

renews.zh: 每两年续期一次（10 美元）。

plain.en: Lets you take Wisconsin income tax out of paychecks.
plain.zh: 让您可以从工资中代扣威斯康星州所得税。

proof.quote: Every employer who is required to withhold Wisconsin income tax must register with the Wisconsin Department of Revenue

title.zh: 失业保险雇主登记

agency.en: Wisconsin Department of Workforce Development, Unemployment Insurance
agency.zh: 威斯康星州劳动力发展局失业保险处

how.en: Once the business meets a coverage condition (for most, paying Wisconsin wages while liable under the federal unemployment tax), complete the online New Employer Registration for a UI account number.
how.zh: 企业满足覆盖条件后（多数情况为在负有联邦失业税义务时支付威斯康星州工资），在线填写新雇主登记以取得失业保险账号。

feeNote.en: DWD's page lists no registration fee.
feeNote.zh: 劳动力发展局页面未列出登记费。

plain.en: Registers you as an employer with the state once you have staff.
plain.zh: 有员工后，向州政府登记为雇主。

proof.quote: You are required to pay UI contributions on your payroll after you've met a statutory coverage liability condition.

form: Food Processing Plant License (Wis. Admin. Code ch. ATCP 70)

title.zh: 威斯康星州食品加工厂执照

agency.en: Wisconsin Department of Agriculture, Trade and Consumer Protection (DATCP), Division of Food and Recreational Safety
agency.zh: 威斯康星州农业、贸易与消费者保护厅（DATCP）食品与休闲安全处

how.en: A business that makes or packs food to sell mainly through wholesale distribution holds a food processing plant license from DATCP.
how.zh: 生产或包装食品并主要通过批发渠道销售的企业，须持有 DATCP 签发的食品加工厂执照。

feeNote.en: From $95 to $835 a year by annual production and whether the food is potentially hazardous or canned (DATCP's fee schedule).
feeNote.zh: 每年 95 至 835 美元，按年产值以及是否为易腐危害性食品或罐头食品确定（DATCP 收费表）。

renews.en: Every year; the license expires March 31.
renews.zh: 每年续期，执照于 3 月 31 日到期。

plain.en: The state license for a food plant in Wisconsin that sells to stores and distributors.
plain.zh: 威斯康星州向商店和分销商供货的食品工厂所需的州执照。

proof.quote: If you plan to sell primarily through wholesale distribution, you will need a food processing plant license issued by our Department.

form: Food Warehouse License (Wis. Admin. Code ch. ATCP 71)

title.zh: 威斯康星州食品仓库执照

agency.en: Wisconsin Department of Agriculture, Trade and Consumer Protection (DATCP), Division of Food and Recreational Safety
agency.zh: 威斯康星州农业、贸易与消费者保护厅（DATCP）食品与休闲安全处

how.en: A food warehouse in Wisconsin holds a DATCP food warehouse license. A public storage warehouse also needs the separate public warehouse license.
how.zh: 威斯康星州的食品仓库须持有 DATCP 食品仓库执照。公共仓储仓库另须办理公共仓库执照。

feeNote.en: From $80 to $320 a year by floor area and whether it stores potentially hazardous food (DATCP's fee schedule).
feeNote.zh: 每年 80 至 320 美元，按面积以及是否储存易腐危害性食品确定（DATCP 收费表）。

renews.en: Every year; the license expires June 30.
renews.zh: 每年续期，执照于 6 月 30 日到期。

plain.en: The state license for a warehouse that stores food in Wisconsin.
plain.zh: 威斯康星州储存食品的仓库所需的州执照。

proof.quote: FOOD WAREHOUSE: License expires annually, June 30

title.zh: 明尼苏达州预扣税登记

how.en: Register for withholding before you start withholding from wages: get a Minnesota Tax ID in e-Services, or add a withholding account to the Tax ID you already have.
how.zh: 开始从工资中预扣前登记：通过 e-Services 取得明尼苏达州税号，或在已有税号下添加预扣税账户。

feeNote.en: The Department of Revenue states no fee; registering late can bring a $100 penalty.
feeNote.zh: 税务局未说明费用；逾期登记可能被罚款 100 美元。

plain.en: Lets you take Minnesota income tax out of paychecks. Register before the first payroll.
plain.zh: 让您可以从工资中代扣明尼苏达州所得税。首次发薪前登记。

proof.quote: You must register to file withholding tax if any of these apply:

title.en: Minnesota food handler license (manufacturer or wholesaler)
title.zh: 明尼苏达州食品经营许可（生产商或批发商）

agency.en: Minnesota Department of Agriculture, Food and Feed Safety Division
agency.zh: 明尼苏达州农业厅食品与饲料安全处

how.en: A food manufacturer or wholesale food handler (a packaged food warehouse included) asks the MDA Licensing Liaison for the Applicant Form, then the MDA reviews the plan and inspects before the license. The MDA has no online application.
how.zh: 食品生产商或食品批发经营者（包括包装食品仓库）须向农业厅许可联络员索取申请表，经计划审核和检查后发证。农业厅暂无在线申请。

feeNote.en: A $50 pre-licensing applicant form fee, then a license fee set by gross annual food sales and food safety risk.
feeNote.zh: 预申请表费用 50 美元，之后按年食品销售额和食品安全风险确定执照费。

renews.en: Every year; from 2027 the license runs January 1 to December 31.
renews.zh: 每年续期；自 2027 年起执照期为 1 月 1 日至 12 月 31 日。

plain.en: The state food license for a food maker or food warehouse in Minnesota.
plain.zh: 明尼苏达州食品生产商或食品仓库所需的州食品许可。

proof.quote: If you would like to operate as a wholesale food handler or manufacturer, you will need a Food Handler License.

title.en: Minnesota food handler license (grocery or retail food store)
title.zh: 明尼苏达州食品经营许可（食品杂货或零售食品店）

agency.en: Minnesota Department of Agriculture, Food and Feed Safety Division
agency.zh: 明尼苏达州农业厅食品与饲料安全处

how.en: A grocery store, convenience store, meat market or bakery contacts MDA Licensing (mda.licensing@state.mn.us) for the application, sends a retail plan review if required, and pays the license fee. Some cities and counties license food stores themselves.
how.zh: 食品杂货店、便利店、肉店或面包房须联系农业厅许可部门（mda.licensing@state.mn.us）索取申请表，按要求提交零售计划审核，并缴纳执照费。部分市县自行为食品店发证。

feeNote.en: Set by business size and food safety risk.
feeNote.zh: 按企业规模和食品安全风险确定。

plain.en: The state food license for a grocery or other food store in Minnesota.
plain.zh: 明尼苏达州食品杂货店等食品店所需的州食品许可。

proof.quote: I want to operate a grocery store, convenience store, meat market, bakery, vending machine, or food warehouse.

form: Iowa Business Tax Permit Registration (78-005), sales and use tax

title.zh: 爱荷华州销售税许可

how.en: Register online in GovConnectIowa (or on Form 78-005). You may collect tax as soon as the registration is submitted; the permit letter can come in one business day.
how.zh: 在 GovConnectIowa 在线登记（或填写 78-005 表）。提交登记后即可开始收税，许可函最快一个工作日寄达。

feeNote.en: The permits are free.
feeNote.zh: 许可免费。

foreign.en: Iowa asks for each owner's Social Security number; an owner without one asks the Department how to proceed.
foreign.zh: 爱荷华州要求填写每位股东的社会安全号；没有的股东须向税务局询问办理方式。

plain.en: Lets you charge sales tax in Iowa. Free, and you can start collecting once you've applied.
plain.zh: 让您可以在爱荷华州收取销售税。免费，提交申请后即可开始收税。

proof.quote: Your business must register for a separate permit number for the following tax types:

form: Iowa Business Tax Permit Registration (78-005), withholding tax

title.zh: 爱荷华州预扣税许可

how.en: Register for a withholding tax permit online in GovConnectIowa, or on Form 78-005.
how.zh: 在 GovConnectIowa 在线登记预扣税许可，或填写 78-005 表。

feeNote.en: The permits are free.
feeNote.zh: 许可免费。

plain.en: Lets you take Iowa income tax out of paychecks. Free.
plain.zh: 让您可以从工资中代扣爱荷华州所得税。免费。

proof.quote: Your business must register for a separate permit number for the following tax types:

title.zh: 失业保险雇主登记

agency.zh: 爱荷华州劳动力发展局

how.en: Register a UI tax account in myIowaUI within 30 days after the first wages are paid in Iowa; an out-of-state employer registers as soon as it pays someone working in Iowa.
how.zh: 在爱荷华州首次支付工资后 30 天内，通过 myIowaUI 登记失业保险税账户；州外雇主一旦向在爱荷华州工作的员工支付工资即须登记。

feeNote.en: IWD's page lists no registration fee.
feeNote.zh: 劳动力发展局页面未列出登记费。

takes.en: Within 30 days of the first Iowa payroll.
takes.zh: 须在爱荷华州首次发薪后 30 天内。

plain.en: Registers you as an employer with the state within 30 days of the first payroll.
plain.zh: 首次发薪后 30 天内，向州政府登记为雇主。

proof.quote: all employers must register a UI tax account with Iowa Workforce Development (IWD)

form: Food license application (DIAL online food licensing)

title.en: Iowa food license (food establishment or food processing plant)
title.zh: 爱荷华州食品执照（食品场所或食品加工厂）

agency.en: Iowa Department of Inspections, Appeals, and Licensing (DIAL)
agency.zh: 爱荷华州检查、申诉与许可厅（DIAL）

how.en: Apply online in DIAL's food licensing system, one license per location, choosing the right inspection jurisdiction (DIAL or a contracted county or city). The license is emailed when approved.
how.zh: 在 DIAL 的在线食品许可系统申请，每个地点一张执照，并选择正确的检查辖区（DIAL 或签约的县市）。获批后执照通过电子邮件发送。

feeNote.en: Set by license type and the previous year's gross sales; a new application without them pays the maximum.
feeNote.zh: 按执照类型和上一年度总销售额确定；新申请未提供销售额的按最高标准缴费。

plain.en: The state food license for a restaurant, food store, food plant or food warehouse in Iowa.
plain.zh: 爱荷华州餐厅、食品店、食品工厂或食品仓库所需的州食品执照。

proof.quote: A separate license must be applied for each location where food production, sales or service will take place.

form: Form 2643, Missouri Tax Registration Application (retail sales tax)

title.zh: 密苏里州零售销售税执照

how.en: Register on the Department of Revenue's online new business registration in MyTax Missouri, or sign and mail Form 2643. The signer is an owner, partner, officer or member named on the application.
how.zh: 在 MyTax Missouri 的税务局在线新企业登记中办理，或签署 2643 表邮寄。签署人须为申请表所列的所有人、合伙人、高管或成员。

feeNote.en: The Department's page states no fee. A bond is no longer required in most cases.
feeNote.zh: 税务局页面未说明费用。多数情况下已不再要求保证金。

takes.en: About 10 business days for a retail sales tax application.
takes.zh: 零售销售税申请约需 10 个工作日。

plain.en: Lets you charge sales tax in Missouri. Allow about two weeks.
plain.zh: 让您可以在密苏里州收取销售税。约需两周。

proof.quote: A business must obtain a sales tax license by registering with the Department of Revenue if it’s making sales of tangible personal property

form: Form 2643, Missouri Tax Registration Application (employer withholding)

title.zh: 密苏里州雇主预扣税登记

how.en: Get a Missouri Employer Tax Identification Number on the same online registration (or Form 2643) before paying wages in Missouri.
how.zh: 在密苏里州支付工资前，通过同一在线登记（或 2643 表）取得密苏里州雇主税号。

feeNote.en: The Department's page states no fee.
feeNote.zh: 税务局页面未说明费用。

plain.en: Lets you take Missouri income tax out of paychecks.
plain.zh: 让您可以从工资中代扣密苏里州所得税。

proof.quote: making payment of wages to a resident or nonresident individual must obtain a Missouri Employer Tax Identification Number

title.zh: 失业保险雇主登记

agency.en: Missouri Department of Labor and Industrial Relations, Division of Employment Security
agency.zh: 密苏里州劳工与劳资关系厅就业保障处

how.en: Notify the Division within 30 days of becoming liable as an employer (for most, owing federal unemployment tax and employing a worker in Missouri), online in UInteract or on the combined state registration.
how.zh: 成为负有义务的雇主后（多数情况为负有联邦失业税义务并在密苏里州雇用员工），须在 30 天内通过 UInteract 或州联合登记在线通知就业保障处。

feeNote.en: DES's page lists no registration fee.
feeNote.zh: 就业保障处页面未列出登记费。

takes.zh: 须在负有义务后 30 天内。

plain.en: Registers you as an employer with the state within 30 days of hiring.
plain.zh: 雇人后 30 天内，向州政府登记为雇主。

proof.quote: An employing unit needs to notify the Division when it becomes liable to pay taxes as an employer.
